column2: Claude, Chrome's gatekeeping. My API works in Postman. Here? CORS.
Since when do you have a board?
Since now. Your page: localhost, port three thousand. Your API: same host, port eight thousand.
Different port, different origin. And Chrome checks the API's guest list.
Sometimes a preflight check stops it. Otherwise, Chrome hides the response unless your origin is on the list.
Postman isn't a browser. It never checks the guest list.
So I fix it in the front end?
Server side. Add Access-Control-Allow-Origin with your page's exact origin. Guests don't write the guest list.
Allowed my page's exact origin on the server... It loaded!
